Energy transition specialist with 10+ years of experience advising governments, industry, and research institutions on decarbonization strategy, clean energy markets, and ecosystem development across Asia and the Middle East. Proven track record in structuring net-zero pathways, evaluating emerging technologies (hydrogen, CCUS, renewables), and translating policy and market insights into actionable strategic recommendations. Experienced in multi-stakeholder engagement, sector strategy development, and delivering advisory inputs to senior decision-makers.

## Currently

Research Lead, Climate and Sustainability programme at KAPSARC working on Saudi Arabia's net-zero ecosystem, with a focus on renewable deployment pathways, CCUS, hydrogen, and sectoral decarbonization. Ongoing work on scenario analysis using integrated assessment frameworks, and on the regulatory and market conditions needed to translate transition targets into roadmaps.

## Selected work

**Saudi Arabia's net-zero pathways** — Multi-stakeholder initiative structuring decarbonization pathways across hydrogen, CCUS, and renewables. *(KAPSARC)*

**Coal transition and power system risk in India** — Co-edited volume and modeling work on infrastructure constraints, demand evolution, and transition risks in India's power sector. *(Brookings India / CSEP)*

**State-level clean energy pathways in India** — Renewable deployment strategies and investment priorities developed with utilities, regulators, and investors. *(CEEW)*
